description: Sales Heatmap is a live sales overview widget for Uno Platform: a 12 by 8 activity heatmap, monthly and yearly totals with their change, and the top three regions. An MVUX feed publishes a new sales snapshot every two seconds and the page shows it in a FeedView; the widget eases its figures toward each snapshot, colours each change green or red, drifts the heatmap cells and blinks a live indicator. It uses MVUX, Navigation Extensions, the Toolkit and Material.

showcase.summary: A live sales overview card with an animated heatmap, fed by an MVUX feed.
goals: An MVUX feed built from an async enumerable, shown in a FeedView with a progress state
A reusable UserControl that takes its data through one dependency property
Figures that ease toward each new snapshot and stop the easing timer once they settle
A heatmap of plain XAML rectangles that updates a cell only when its colour bucket changes
A card that keeps its layout at 400 wide and scales down to fit a phone
